name: Lethal Werewolf Bite
description:
Sink your hybrid werewolf fangs savagely into an adjacent enemy, delivering lethal werewolf venom into their bloodstream. Against mortals and monsters, the venom rots flesh and causes excruciating agony. Against vampires, the venom is an absolute, incurable death sentence!

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 40 ml

name: Call the Hybrids
description:
The hybrids you sired with the doppelganger's blood are bound to you.  Whistle, and a pack of them comes running on four legs to fight for you for half an hour.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 300 ml
message: Wolves answer from the dark and come loping to your side.
